base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y cmake libblas-dev liblapack-dev liblapacke-dev python3-venv python3-dev git curl
setup_runtime_commands:
mkdir -p /root/.pip && cat > /root/.pip/pip.conf << 'EOF'
[global]
index-url = http://mirror.proxy.hpc:8081/repository/pypi-proxy/simple/
trusted-host = mirror.proxy.hpc
timeout = 300
EOF
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'source /opt/benchmark/mlx_env/bin/activate && source /opt/benchmark/mlx_env/bin/mlx_activate.sh && python -c "import mlx.core as mx; print(mx.__version__)"'

prepare_commands: pip install nanobind cmake numpy torch
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: test dependencies (numpy, torch) installed at build time
runtime_profile.notes: MLX requires LD_LIBRARY_PATH to include /workspace/python/mlx/lib for the shared library. Build with MLX_BUILD_METAL=OFF for Linux compatibility. Uses internal PyPI proxy (mirror.proxy.hpc:8081) for network reliability. Pip timeout set to 600 seconds for MLX build (5-10 min C++ compilation), 300 seconds for other packages. setuptools<82 required for torch compatibility. The mlx_activate.sh script sets LD_LIBRARY_PATH automatically. Base image: python:3.11-slim recommended for nanobind/MLX compatibility.

notes: MLX is Apple's ML framework with C++ core and Python bindings. Linux builds require disabling Metal GPU support. The editable install creates a .pth file but the shared library (libmlx.so) requires explicit LD_LIBRARY_PATH configuration. Updated setup_runtime.sh to use internal PyPI proxy (PIP_INDEX_URL=http://mirror.proxy.hpc:8081/repository/pypi-proxy/simple/) with 600-second timeout for MLX build (5-10 min C++ compilation). Pip timeout configured via environment variable (PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=300) and pip.conf file. Fixed setup_runtime.sh to: 1) use 'set -o pipefail' for proper exit code propagation, 2) remove '| tail -20' masking, 3) add BUILD_EXIT_CODE error handling with build log capture. Changed base image from python:3.13-slim to python:3.11-slim for better nanobind/MLX compatibility. Test runner confirmed working with unittest (10 tests in test_random.py).
